description: This file defines the Builder class responsible for constructing and managing a tree structure of directories and content pages, including functions for ignoring certain files, creating content objects, sorting, and finalizing navigation links.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A class providing static methods for building and managing a directory and content tree structure, including ignoring files, creating content objects, sorting, and linking pages.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a file should be ignored based on its filename and ignore rules.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Extracts the filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Recursively builds a directory tree starting from a node, ignoring specified files, and creating directory or content objects.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates a content or raw object for a file, based on its extension and configuration.

methods.name: removeSortingInformations
methods.description: Removes numeric prefixes or sorting info from filenames.

methods.name: getOrCreateDir
methods.description: Retrieves an existing directory entry by title or creates a new one.

methods.name: getOrCreatePage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a page object for a given path, handling extensions and static configuration.

methods.name: sortTree
methods.description: Recursively sorts directories and their entries.

methods.name: finalizeTree
methods.description: Sets next and previous links for all content pages in the directory tree.
